name: End End Summer
source:
---A young girl wakes up in a hospital while on a summer vacation trip.

Suddenly, she was told of her mother's death. She didn't believe what anyone told her.
"Where is my mother?"

The girl eventually runs away from it all, returning home alone.
But there was no one there.

"I finally understand," she said, 
"My tears were falling onto the floor, 
and my fingernails dug into my hands when I clenched my palms, 
and it hurt. It hurts, it hurts. Ah, it's all so real."

Unable to accept a world without her mother, the girl hugged her knees and waited only for her mother's return.
She lived in uncertainty and loneliness, as if she were atop a castle in the sand.
She dreamed only of sinking into the sea, and these dreams gradually drove her heart mad.
"Mother, come home soon..."

One night, a stranger appeared before the girl's eyes.

Knowing that the girl had run away from the hospital, the man came to her house to coerce her.
"I will allow you to stay here, but I will keep an eye on you."

The girl is repulsed, but she can't escape.
"I can't go anywhere. I just want to stay here forever..."

There are only 10 days left until the end of summer vacation.
A girl and a man begin a strange life together.

[Translated from [url=http://meltself.web.fc2.com/ees/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
---一个年轻女孩在暑假旅行时在医院醒来。

突然，她得知母亲去世的消息。她不相信任何人告诉她的话。
“我妈妈在哪儿？”

女孩最终逃离了这一切，独自回到了家。
但那里没有人。

她说：“我终于明白了，
“我的眼泪掉到了地板上，
当我握紧手掌时，我的指甲陷进了我的手里，
很痛。很痛，很痛。啊，这一切都是那么真实。”

女孩无法接受没有母亲的世界，她抱着膝盖，只等待母亲的归来。
她生活在不确定和孤独之中，仿佛她生活在沙堡之上。
她的梦想只是沉入大海，这些梦想逐渐让她的心发疯。
“妈妈，你快点回家吧……”

一天晚上，女孩的眼前出现了一位陌生人。

得知女孩逃离医院后，男子来到女孩家胁迫女孩。
“我允许你留在这里，但我会监视你。”

女孩很排斥，但又无法逃脱。
“我哪儿也去不了，我只想永远留在这里……”

距离暑假结束只剩下10天了。
一个女孩和一个男人一起开始了奇怪的生活。”

[译自[url=http://meltself.web.fc2.com/ees/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
